interpretation: The auditor abstained with no_obvious_headroom on 82/200 traces rather than manufacturing an optimization recommendation.

Repeated tool-name structure appeared in 51/200 traces, but only 28/200 contained an exact repeated tool+normalized-input signature, preserving the distinction same tool sequence != same transformation.
Failure/retry investigation was the dominant hypothesis on this NL2Bash workload because 110/200 traces contained nonzero tool exit codes or other failure signals.
The 10,000-token context threshold was rarely crossed on this small-model workload; context compression is therefore not the dominant optimization hypothesis for this dataset.
This benchmark establishes parser/decision usefulness on public traces, not customer demand, verified savings, creator revenue, or universal generalization.
